brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps (market says possible at volume) and cut payment to 30 days to free up ₹2.25 L cash

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps at our volumes
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows typical price is ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with modest headroom down to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec — we buy ₹27.42 L/year, so we qualify for that lower band

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹2.25 L cash freed up for us

brief.financialLeverage: This supplier publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit or cash position. That means we lean on our own data and the market: the open market says there's room to move on price, and we have strong listed alternates ready to qualify. Our ₹27.42 L spend gives us weight, but without their numbers we keep the ask firm yet professional — focus on lining up a second source to show we're serious.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate with B health score and ₹2569.83 Cr revenue

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma); strong, profitable — a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: A manufacturer lead found by web research — verify before RFQ

risks: No public financials means we can't spot early warning signs of trouble — keep an eye on delivery consistency and quality as proxies for their stability
If we push too hard without a qualified second source live, they may walk and leave us exposed — start the alternate RFQs now
Market headroom is 'modest' — the ₹0.65–0.80 floor assumes higher volume or relaxed spec, so confirm our order size and tolerances support that ask
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership and want to lock in a three-year deal — to do that, we need pricing that reflects our ₹27 lakh annual volume and 30-day payment to match the rest of our packaging suppliers.
